name: Chargebee
desc: Subscription billing and revenue operations platform for managing customers and subscriptions.

actions.name: create_subscription
actions.description: Create a subscription for an existing customer using a Chargebee item price.

actions.name: cancel_subscription
actions.description: Cancel a Chargebee subscription immediately, at end of term, or on a specific date.

actions.name: get_customer
actions.description: Retrieve a customer from Chargebee by ID.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: subscription_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new subscription is created for a customer.

triggers.name: subscription_cancelled
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription is cancelled.

triggers.name: subscription_renewed
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription is successfully renewed.

triggers.name: subscription_changed
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription is updated — plan change, quantity, or add-ons.

triggers.name: payment_succeeded
triggers.description: Triggers when a payment is successfully collected.

triggers.name: payment_failed
triggers.description: Triggers when a payment attempt fails. Useful for dunning and retry workflows.

triggers.name: invoice_generated
triggers.description: Triggers when a new invoice is generated for a subscription.

triggers.name: customer_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new customer is created in Chargebee.
